name: Iede Shoujo ~Onna no Ko o Hiroimashita~
original_name: 家出少女 ～ 女の子を拾いました ～
source:
A moving story begins──
You find a runaway girl and change her life. An adventure to nurture bonds and overcome difficulties awaits. Her future is in your hands.

Let's take the hand of a runaway girl who is at a loss and open up a new path. Her destiny depends on your choices. Her emotional journey begins—your kindness and her courage will help her save her life.

[Taken from [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.IedeGirl] Official download[/url]]
